candidate.title: The previously deprecated `metallb-bgp` flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` have been removed
candidate.text: The previously deprecated `metallb-bgp` flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip` and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` have been removed. Users are now required to use Cilium BGP control plane for BGP advertisements.

evidence.excerpt:
* The previously deprecated `metallb-bgp` flags `bgp-config-path`, `bgp-announce-lb-ip`
  and `bgp-announce-pod-cidr` have been removed. Users are now required to use Cilium BGP
  control plane for BGP advertisements.
